scope: Worker visual QA only; manager visual acceptance and browser validation pending.
styleAssessment: The normalized stills match the recent v3/v4/v5 compact head/body proportions, dark stepped contours, muted clothing palette, eye rendering, directional shading and pixel texture. Reviewed native sheets, light/dark pose proofs, all four existing-band boards, all 20 nearest-six comparisons, 80 seated-contact overlays and all 20 south-facing chair proofs.
limitations: Style similarity remains a visual judgment; hashes, RMSE and geometry checks do not establish artistic equivalence. Some early legacy catalog sprites have smaller heads and taller bodies than the recent reference cohorts, so they are included in comparisons without changing the established v5 normalization.

007's regenerated native sheet looks slightly smoother at full source size; its normalized dark contour and shading remain consistent with the recent cohorts. Manager should inspect this identity closely.

The draped skirt/cardigan/culotte contacts for 003, 006, 007, 016 and 017 are manually authored estimates of support placement. South-facing chair composites are provided; no approved east/west/north chair support exists in this proof fixture.
Stylized faces do not demonstrate exact age. Sex and age remain explicit identity metadata within the assigned bands.
Only alpha-1 fringe noise occurs outside normalized footprints or on output borders. Native pixels are preserved; the manager's acceptance of this exact alpha report remains pending.
